title: AIB protocols (chipsalliance/aib-protocols)
_note: chipsalliance/aib-protocols (Eximius Design, Apache-2.0): the protocol layers riding on the AIB die-to-die PHY -- the logic-link (llink) channel aligner and FIFOs, the AXI4-MM / AXI4-Stream / AXI4-ST-duplex leader+follower generated configurations, the LPIF (CXL/PCIe link-layer PHY interface) tx/rx at every width, the SPI-AIB bridge and the channel-alignment (ca) block.  Roots are the rtl/ directories and the generated configuration directories under axi4-*/; llink/script/premade_examples duplicates 49 of the axi4 modules file-for-file and is excluded as a source, as are the dv/, sims/, backup/ and fpga/ trees.  The full_examples*/common tops are swept as rows on purpose: they are the user-facing integration examples, and a row that cannot close over the AIB PHY models says so in its note.  LPIF modules `include lpif_configs.svh` (localparams over their own parameters).  Closure facts from the first survey: marker_gen and strobe_gen live in common/dv/ but are instantiated by the lpif / lpif_txrx / axi_st RTL, so those two files are roots while the rest of dv/ stays excluded.  Excluded as rows: aximm_aib_top, axist_aib_top and top_aib (multi-die examples instantiating emib_m2s2, a DV interconnect model that lives in aib-phy-hardware's v2.0/rev1/dv) and six axi4-st example tops that instantiate generated configurations no file in the repository defines (axi_st_master_top, axi_st_d256_dual_multichannel_full_*: outputs of llink/script for a user's own parameters).

axi_st_patchkr_top.note: read-fail is the SOURCE: `always @(posedge wrclk or negedge rst_n) if (!rst_n || patchkr_en)` gates the asynchronous reset arm with a synchronous enable, which no synthesis frontend accepts -- read_verilog stops at the same 'Multiple edge sensitive events', read_slang at 'condition cannot be matched to any signal from the event list'.
